title: Close out Phase 3: PR, CI gate, retro, then plan the move
description:
Per .tick/config.md: push the epic branch, open a PR, do not complete close-out until CI is green. No direct merge to main.

Retro against 9hu's definition of done, verifying the code.

THEN PLAN PHASE 5 (5hm) — the move itself, and the biggest phase in the project. It already carries notes from earlier phases that must not be lost: the tk-contract scanner must move with the call sites or be replaced; cloud_logs.go and cloud_supervisor.go leave with tk cloud so the factory-free build closure falls out for free; the sandbox image installs two binaries with required-tk-commands split by owner; and embedded.go at the module root welds skills+factory+sandbox into one go:embed unit, which is the hardest structural blocker in the project.

Also note for the release: 0.32.0 is deliberately held UNRELEASED in the changelog until the extraction settles what ships from where. Phase 5 or 6 is where that unblocks, and whoever closes it should say so.
acceptance_criteria: A PR exists with green CI; not merged directly to main. The retro verifies the code against 9hu's acceptance. Phase 5 has child ticks and a complete EPIC-SKELETON, and its plan accounts for the four inherited notes named above.
